summary: validate-modules codes for deprecation mismatches and doc vs argument_spec mismatches in choices, default, elements, type and required.

answer_card.title: validate-modules codes (doc vs spec)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `deprecation-mismatch`: deprecation not marked in file name, metadata and DOCUMENTATION all together
- `doc-choices-do-not-match-spec`, `doc-default-does-not-match-spec`: docs differ from argument_spec
- `doc-*-incompatible-type`: doc value not compatible with spec type
- `doc-elements-invalid` / `doc-elements-mismatch`: elements wrong or set without `type: list`
- `doc-missing-type`: doc lacks a type
- `doc-required-mismatch`: required differs between spec and docs
